# Causal Directed Acyclic Graphs

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Pass the vector directly. Knitr will re-read this vector freshly for EVERY chunk.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(engine.opts = list(
  template = "../tikz_template.tex",
  convert = "dvisvgm" # Keeps your math italics beautiful!
))
```


![Counfounding DAG](fig/img1-confounding.png){width=80% fig-align="center"}

```{r}
#| engine: tikz
#| fig-ext: png
#| fig-dpi: 300

    \begin{tikzpicture}[->,>=Stealth]
    \node[] (D) at (0,0) {$\underline{D}$};
    \node[] (L) at (2.5,1) {$L$};
    \node[] (R) at (5,0) {$\overline{R}$};
    
      \path 
    	(D)  edge  [very thick, color=blue]  (R)  
    	(L)  edge  [very thick, color=red, dashed]  (D)			
    	(L)  edge  [very thick, color=red, dashed]  (R)			
    	;
    \end{tikzpicture}
```


```{r}
#| engine: tikz
#| fig-ext: png
#| fig-dpi: 300

    \begin{tikzpicture}[->,>=Stealth]
    \node[] (D) at (0,0) {$D$};
    \node[draw] (L) at (2.5,1) {$L$};
    \node[] (R) at (5,0) {$R$};
    
      \path 
    	(D)  edge  [very thick, color=blue]  (R)  
    	(L)  edge  [very thick, dashed]  (D)			
    	(L)  edge  [very thick, dashed]  (R)			
    	;
    \end{tikzpicture}
```
